WePresent is the award-winning arts platform of WeTransfer, dedicated to collaborating with and championing the work of creative people all around the world, and bringing artistic projects to life to share with WeTransfer’s global audience of more than 80 million people a month.

What sets us apart is the fact we work with artists, as opposed to simply reporting on them. We’re not brand sponsors; we’re collaborators and curators.
